mentions.name: wickeTS
mentions.description: A frontend framework for TypeScript based on Apache Wicket's concepts, chosen because Wicket scored highest in the author's IVP-based analysis of frontend frameworks across Java, JavaScript, .NET, and PHP. Server-side rendering is partially implemented, with planned support for client-side rendering, static site generation, and accessibility standards. The author intends to use it for a knowledge base website about the IVP.
mentions.source_excerpt: Today I have started vibe-coding a frontend framework called wickeTS based on Apache Wicket's concepts, but for TypeScript.
